Application Data.NAME: Clean Sweep Vacuum Sales & Service
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Clean Sweep Vacuum Sales & Service specializes in the retail sale and servicing of residential and commercial vacuum cleaners. Our operations include offering a wide selection of vacuum products, providing professional repairs with a focus on quality control, and delivering demonstrations in a controlled environment. We maintain a designated service area separate from our retail space to minimize customer exposure to equipment hazards. Our trained staff adheres to strict safety protocols, ensuring proper handling of products during sales and repair processes. We also have established quality control measures in place for the vacuum cleaners we sell and service, enhancing customer satisfaction and reducing risks associated with product defects.
